{{Otheruses|Wood}}
'''Veshok wood''' was a type of hard and sturdy [[Wood/Legends|wood]]<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> hewn from the [[veshok]] [[Tree/Legends|trees]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Veshok wood possessed a grain similar to that of [[oak tree]]s,<ref name="Dictionary">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref> and produced a large amount of heat when [[Fire/Legends|burned]].<ref name="ImpCom501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> Due to the large number of veshok trees that grew on Mandalore—with sprawling veshok forests covering most of Mandalore's northern hemisphere, stretching nearly as far as the planet's polar [[Water/Legends|ice]] cap<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>—veshok wood became a favored material for [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] craftsmen to work with. Over the ages, veshok wood was used in the construction of homes,<ref name="Sacrifice" /> furniture,<ref name="O66" /> outdoor fencing, and even handcrafted toys for young Mandalorian [[Youngling/Legends|children]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
Veshok wood was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel, [[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice|''Sacrifice'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[May 29]], [[2007]].<ref name="Sacrifice" /> In the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] dictionary compiled by Traviss, she noted that though veshok trees were intended to be large evergreens, veshok wood was nevertheless possessed of a wood grain more similar to that of oak trees.<ref name="Dictionary" />
